abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches. This is a HERO static over 'YOUR attacks', so it takes ATTACK_CONTROLLED_BY_YOU rather than SOURCE_IS_ATTACK -- the buffed card is the attack, not the hero.

The form was in `target`, a key TRANSFORM_HERO does not read. It happened to name the default, so this one was right by accident -- the same misspelling on invoke_azvolai_red named a token and transformed the hero instead.

_comment: Retriggered ON_HIT -> ON_ANY_HIT. ON_HIT now means "when THIS hits" and is dispatched only to the attack itself; this card's text is about an attack its CONTROLLER makes, so it needs the broadcast trigger. Before the split, ON_HIT was broadcast to every permanent the attacker controlled, which was right for this card and wrong for the seven weapons reading "when THIS hits" that fired on any attack at all.
